demo.reason: Live watts, graph movement, comparisons, energy accumulation, and cost are more convincing when the values visibly change together.

features.title: See what the watts add up to.
features.subtitle: Pro turns one measured power source into useful energy and cost context without inventing totals.
items: Integrated Wh and kWh become an estimated cost using the electricity rate you set.
Extra iCUE power sensors keep separate traces and values instead of being silently combined.
Local daily energy and completed-session summaries make the data useful beyond the current moment.
The primary label follows the selected iCUE sensor scope, so CPU power is never presented as whole-PC power.

showcase.title: One meter. More context.
showcase.subtitle: Live draw, rolling history, energy, cost, and separate comparison traces stay visible in one dashboard.
